verdict.rationale: Kit's own docs list "Audience tagging & segmentation" as a product feature, and broadcasts can target segment or tag IDs, so segments exist natively. The evidence says nothing about how segments are built: no criteria from custom-field attributes, tags or behavioral events, and no statement that segments update automatically as data changes. Custom fields are documented as subscriber attributes, but nothing links them to segment rules. Missing for 10: documented segment-builder criteria (attributes, tags, behavioral events), evidence that segments stay live and dynamic as data changes, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can build audience segments from profile attributes, tags, and behavioral events, and they stay live as data changes

citations.quote: We currently support targeting your subscribers based on segment or tag ids.
